content.introduction: According to Bloomberg, the Health Care sector has a weight of 11% and a % change of 0.11% as of November 6, 2026. The Health Care Equipment & Services sub-sector holds a weight of 32% and a % change of 4.32%, while the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences sub-sector has a weight of 68% and a % change of 2.43%. The overall performance of all sectors is at 100% with a % change of 0.31%.
